title: fix(types): export correct types from search-insights
body:
<!--

**Summary**

This PR exports the correct types from `search-insights` package instead of having own types within the repo.

This fixes https://github.com/algolia/search-insights.js/issues/330

**Result**

It works the same, but likely no (or less) type errors.
